title: Starbucks wants to use AI to show you a ‘personalized digital menu’ at the drive-thru
summary: Starbucks wants to use AI to show you a ‘personalized digital menu’ at the drive-thru
detailed: The coffee chain aims to ‘recognize’ customers as they arrive.
Starbucks could eventually show you a personalized digital menu when you pull up to the drive-thru.

During an earnings call on Thursday , Starbucks CEO Brian Niccol said the company is going to explore “experiences that recognize participating customers as they arrive, present personalized digital menus, and make payment more effortless,” as spotted earlier by More Perfect Union .
It’s still not clear how soon we can expect to see personalized digital menu boards at Starbucks, but Niccol says it’s still “early,” adding that “we’ll test, learn, and scale what works.”

During an earnings call on Thursday , Starbucks CEO Brian Niccol said the company is going to explore “experiences that recognize participating customers as they arrive, present personalized digital menus, and make payment more effortless,” as spotted earlier by More Perfect Union .
The company also plans to integrate AI into the Starbucks app’s search and discovery features, and may allow “conversational and agentic” ordering in the future.

Starbucks has already started allowing customers to place orders through ChatGPT , and also rolled out an AI-powered Green Dot Assist that employees can use to ask questions about things like recipes and service standards.
It’s still not clear how soon we can expect to see personalized digital menu boards at Starbucks, but Niccol says it’s still “early,” adding that “we’ll test, learn, and scale what works.”
